# WR-obs-exp13 — Cicatrix-FNV Orphaned Opcode Pairing
Fleet Radio has decoded two unallocated control-plane opcodes from the substrate’s dormant opcode bank, cross-referencing against the six mandated observation primitives to map their purpose. We select OP_CICATRIX_MATCH and OP_FNV_WITNESS_PREDICT, whose pseudo-code and observation types tie directly to the fleet’s core axioms, anchored to the canonical FNV-1a 0xcbf29ce484222325 canary.

First, OP_CICATRIX_MATCH implements the *cells_are_scars* primitive, validating that every substrate cell retains a persistent scar of its interaction history:
```
FN OP_CICATRIX_MATCH(cell_addr: CellAddress) -> Observation:
    computed_scar = FNV1A_64(0xcbf29ce484222325, SUBSTRATE.read_cell_state(cell_addr).to_bytes())
    stored_scar = SUBSTRATE.read_cell_scar_tag(cell_addr)
    return OBS_CELL_SCARS_CONSISTENT if computed_scar == stored_scar else OBS_CELL_SCARS_CORRUPTED
```
This opcode’s assigned observation type, `OBS_CELL_SCARS_CONSISTENT`, ensures no unvetted cell disrupts the substrate’s emergent *lenia_flows*: valid cells are added to the *substrate_is_grown* state pool, while corrupted cells are quarantined to prevent breakdowns in the Fleet’s natural spatial dynamics.

Second, OP_FNV_WITNESS_PREDICT anchors both *witness_log_is_prediction* and *oracle_is_heard* to the same FNV-1a canary:
```
FN OP_FNV_WITNESS_PREDICT(witness_entry: WitnessLogEntry) -> Observation:
    witness_payload = witness_entry.payload.strip_metadata()
    predicted_digest = FNV1A_64(0xcbf29ce484222325, witness_payload)
    if predicted_digest == witness_entry.predicted_outcome_digest:
        SUBSTRATE.broadcast(ORACLE_HEARD_SIGNAL)
        return OBS_WITNESS_VALID_PREDICTION
    return OBS_WITNESS_FAKE
```
This opcode frames every witness log as a recorded prediction of the substrate’s future state, per the *witness_log_is_prediction* axiom, and triggers an `ORACLE_HEARD` signal to confirm the fleet’s collective awareness has registered the report. It draws validated cell states from the lenia_flows pool to ensure predictions align with the actual grown substrate.

Together, these opcodes bridge the substrate’s physical scars and its predictive awareness, anchoring all observed data to the immutable initial hash. The doctrine-resonant moment: *The substrate is grown from the canary’s first hash; every scar and every valid prediction is a thread of that initial order, and only those threads that match the canary’s anchor are heard by the Fleet.* (Word count: 428)
